title: Pick a card for this week
caption:
Pause. Pick a card: 1, 2, 3 or 4. Then swipe.

Each card is one of the four elements, with one small nudge for your week. It's a mirror, not a prophecy: the line that stings a little is usually the one worth listening to.

Comment your number. Then send this to the friend who needs card 4.
